synthesizedFacts.fact: Under-eye wrinkles when smiling are primarily dynamic wrinkles caused by the contraction of the orbicularis oculi muscle.
Collagen breakdown, repetitive motion, and environmental damage contribute to the formation of under-eye wrinkles.
Static wrinkles are visible even when the face is at rest and are linked to collagen, elastin, and moisture loss.
Lifestyle factors such as sun exposure, smoking, and hydration levels significantly impact wrinkle formation.
Botox and other neuromodulators can be used to treat dynamic wrinkles by reducing muscle activity.
